prose: Jorge Mesa of Third Eye Edify podcast returns to catch us up on his recent research. Jorge is a lifelong musician, teacher, father, and student of the mysteries. What are the habits that make up our day to day life? What aspects of our rituals are made for us, by us? Most importantly, what do we take for granted as normal, that may have been conditioned into us by unknown forces?
